title: Beneficiary
summary: BENEFI'CIARY, adjective [Latin beneficiarius. See Benefaction.] Holding some office or valuable possession, in subordination to another; having a dependent and secondary possession. BENEFI'CIARY, noun

inlines.v: BENEFI'CIARY, adjective [Latin beneficiarius. See Benefaction.] Holding some office or valuable possession, in subordination to another; having a dependent and secondary possession. BENEFI'CIARY, noun One who holds a benefice. A beneficiary is not the proprietor of the revenues of his church; but he has the administration of them, without being accountable to any person. The word was used, in the middle ages, for a feudatory, or vassal. 1. One who receives any thing as a gift, or is maintained by charity.
